summary: Iteration 3 — validated Lives (stage scoping + presence buckets), MANDATORY live gating on request-approval, AI Recommendations tip, Defesa da Fé (apologetics) list/filter/detail, and Intelligent Search (stage-scoped lessons + AI answer). Backend: 42 passed / 2 skipped (skips are expected: (a) blocked-lesson skipped because membro was already advanced past all seeded higher stages by prior iterations; (b) TestMandatoryLiveApproval skipped because membro@caminho.app was already past stage 3 from prior approval runs — expected per the task note). Regression suite still 100%. Frontend: dashboard shows 'Para você hoje' with plain-text tip (no asterisks) + tappable rec-lesson/rec-mission; Perfil → Defesa da Fé lists 6 categories, filter by Eucaristia works, expanding shows Bíblia/Tradição/Catecismo/Magistério; Perfil → Busca Inteligente returns AI answer + lesson/apologetics matches; Lives page shows 3 tabs (Ao vivo / Próximas / Gravadas) and presence buttons. Real Claude Sonnet 4.6 output verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~815 lines; strongly consider splitting into routers (auth, stages, lives, apologetics, search, assistant, admin) — maintainability risk.
GET /api/apologetics ignores its `user` dependency for access control; if in future apologetics gets stage-scoped, add the same live_accessible-style filter used for lives.

GET /api/search silently returns empty `answer` when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is missing or LLM errors — frontend should show a graceful empty-state (currently it just renders nothing for that block, which is acceptable but worth a friendly message).
Recommendations tip system prompt says 'sem markdown' but the model can still slip formatting; consider a post-process strip of ** and leading dashes as a defensive measure.

In seed(), the initial admin/formador/membro user creation is guarded by find_one but their password hashes are not refreshed when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes for non-admin demo users (only admin gets rehashed). Low priority.

success_rate.backend: 100% (42/42 executed, 2 skipped due to prior stage-advancement — expected)

seed_data_creation: Reused seeded demo users. Note: the approval-flow test may have advanced membro@caminho.app another stage; the mandatory-live test dynamically checks and skips if membro is not on stage 3, per task note.
context_for_next_testing_agent: membro@caminho.app has now been advanced multiple times by approval flow — check /auth/me to know its current stage. To re-exercise the mandatory-live gating, reset membro's current_stage_order to 3 (via admin PATCH) and clear its live_attendance for the mandatory stage-3 live, then rerun TestMandatoryLiveApproval. TestStageSecurity::test_blocked_lesson only has coverage if membro's stage < 3 (only stages 1-3 have seeded lessons). All new endpoints /api/lives, /api/lives/{id}/presence, /api/recommendations, /api/apologetics[/{id}], /api/search verified. Frontend routes /app/lives /app/defesa /app/busca fully wired with testids listed in Files_of_reference.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no failures observed. 2 skipped tests are expected by design (stateful stage progression from prior iterations).
